title: 第8章 鸭戏图

content_zh:
偏偏池灿这个人最缺的就是怜香惜玉的情绪，他斜睨着乔昭，没好气道：“现在问这个还有什么用？”
“池大哥不方便说？”乔昭随意牵了牵嘴角。
这人来拜访父亲，以他的身份、年纪推断，定然不是公事，那么十有八九还与他三年前来访的目的有关。
若是那样，她或许能替他达成心愿。并非逞能，只为报答对方的搭救之恩。
至于这人阴晴不定的脾气……咳咳，她和一个变态计较什么。
乔昭说池灿是变态，真算不上骂人。
她对京城中人了解有限，池灿却是个例外，一方面是因为池灿来拜访过祖父，更重要的原因，是他父母的事迹太出名了。
长容长公主是当今圣上胞妹，年少时颇受太后与皇上喜爱。到了可以婚嫁的年纪，长公主千挑万选，亲自挑了个俊朗无双的寒门士子。
用长公主当年的话说，寒门士子比之勋贵子弟少了几分浮夸，为人更踏实可靠。
许是验证了长公主的话，婚后二人举案齐眉，一晃十来年下来别说吵架，连拌嘴都很少。公主尊贵，这其中当然少不得驸马的包容忍让。
一时间，这对神仙眷侣不知惹来多少人艳羡，那些当初不解长容长公主选择的公主们，更是不止一次佩服她的明智。
谁知生活总是比戏本还要精彩，驸马意外过世，长容长公主正悲痛得死去活来之际，一个女人带着一双子女找上门来了，居然是驸马的外室。
更让长公主接受不了的是，外室那双子女竟比独子池灿小不了多少。
十来年的幸福与得意，越是甜蜜羡人，那耳光越是响亮，狠狠抽在了长容长公主的脸上。啪啪啪，脸肿得让长公主连悲痛都剩不下多少了，偏偏那人已死，让她连发泄都没个地方。
不久后，长容长公主公然养起了面首，长公主府夜夜笙歌。
年纪尚幼的池灿面对这一连串变故和那些掩饰得虽好却饱含着各种恶意的人，性情越来越乖戾。加之他相貌随了父亲，越是长大风华越盛，长公主对这个儿子时冷时热，京城的小娘子们却疯狂追逐，让他脾气更加古怪。
这些都是乔昭嫁进靖安侯府后偶尔听来的闲话，她收回思绪，看向池灿的眼神不免带了一点同情。
比起他来，她的父母是多么正常啊！
池灿格外敏感，被少女莫名的眼神刺了一下，冷冷道：“有什么不方便！”
他从上到下扫了乔昭一眼，轻视从上翘的嘴角都能溢出来：“和你说了有什么用！”

乔昭性情疏朗开阔，换做往常或许会随意说笑几句缓解尴尬的气氛，可她家人才遭大难，再怎么豁达此刻也没有闲谈的心思，见他没有说的意思，便不再坚持，淡淡“哦”了一声，捡起池灿丢回去的棋子，接着残局自己与自己下起来。
池灿本来还等着她接话的，结果只等来一声“哦”小姑娘就自娱自乐起来了，当下一口气憋在了嗓子眼里，上不来下不去，一张俊脸都黑了。
“哦”绝对是最讨厌的回话，没有之一！池灿咬牙切齿想。
朱彦看不过去，以拳抵唇轻咳一声：“拾曦，抱歉，若不是我想看乔先生的画，那画就不会被毁了，也不会害你千里迢迢白跑一趟——”
对好友池灿倒是格外宽容，摆摆手道：“现在说这个没意思，我再想别的法子就是了。”
“我父亲手里还有一副韩大家的‘五牛图’——”
池灿打断朱彦的话：“我母亲对那些前朝大家的画都没兴趣，她只稀罕乔先生的画。”
乔昭眸光闪了闪。
长容长公主稀罕祖父的画？
她心思玲珑，很快便想到池灿三年多前找上门来求祖父指点他画技的事。
世人都知道，祖父晚年身体弱，早就没精力教人了，莫非此人求祖父指点画技是假，讨要祖父的画才是真正的目的？
以祖父在文坛的名望地位，当年池灿若直接求画，很可能被一口回绝的。可这人打着求教的名头死死纠缠祖父，最终缠得祖父拿一幅画把人打发了。
乔昭不由深深看了池灿一眼。
那一年，这人不过十五六岁吧，果然不是个简单的。
再想到那些传闻，乔昭更是疑惑。
不是说池灿与长容长公主母子关系僵硬吗，他又怎么会因为长公主稀罕一幅画费这么多心思？

content_en:
However, what Chi Can lacked the most was the emotion of pity and pity. He glanced sideways at Qiao Zhao and said angrily: "What's the use of asking now?"
"Brother Chi, can't you tell me?" Qiao Zhao casually touched the corner of his mouth.
This man came to visit his father. Judging from his identity and age, it was definitely not a business matter, so it was most likely related to the purpose of his visit three years ago.
If so, she might be able to fulfill his wish. It's not to show off, just to repay the other party for the kindness of rescuing him.
As for this person's unstable temper... ahem, what's the point of her arguing with a pervert?
Qiao Zhao said that Chi Can was a pervert, which was really not a curse.
She had limited knowledge of people in the capital, but Chi Can was an exception. On the one hand, it was because Chi Can had come to visit his grandfather, and more importantly, because his parents' deeds were so famous.
Princess Changrong is the younger sister of the current Holy Emperor. She was very popular with the Queen Mother and the Emperor when she was young. When she reached the age where she could get married, the eldest princess had a lot of choices and personally selected an unparalleled handsome man from a poor family.
In the words of the eldest princess back then, a scholar from a poor family was less ostentatious than a disciple from a noble family, and he was more down-to-earth and reliable.
Xu Shi confirmed the eldest princess's words. After the marriage, the two of them had a close relationship. In the past ten years, not to mention quarreling, there were very few quarrels. The princess is noble, and of course the prince-in-law's tolerance is indispensable.
For a time, this immortal couple attracted the envy of many people. Those princesses who were puzzled by Princess Changrong's choice admired her wisdom more than once.
Unexpectedly, life is always more exciting than the script. The prince-in-law passed away unexpectedly, and when the princess Changrong was dying of grief, a woman came to the door with a pair of children, who turned out to be the prince-son-in-law's aunt.
What the eldest princess couldn't accept even more was that the two children in the outer room were not much younger than their only son Chi Can.
The happiness and pride of the past ten years were sweeter and more enviable, the louder the slap was, and it hit the long-faced princess hard on the face. Bang bang bang, her face was so swollen that the eldest princess had little left to grieve, but the man was already dead, leaving her no place to vent.
Not long after, the princess Chang Rong openly showed her good looks, and there were singing and singing every night in the princess's mansion.
Chi Can, who is still young, becomes increasingly surly in the face of this series of changes and those people who, although they are well concealed, are full of malicious intentions. In addition, his appearance took after his father's, and the older he grew, the more prosperous he became. The eldest princess was alternately hot and cold towards this son, but the ladies in the capital chased him crazily, making his temper even weirder.
These were the occasional gossips that Qiao Zhao heard after marrying into the Marquis of Jing'an. She retracted her thoughts and looked at Chi Can with a little sympathy.
How normal her parents were compared to him!
Chi Can was particularly sensitive. He was pricked by the girl's inexplicable eyes and said coldly: "What's the inconvenience?"
He glanced at Qiao Zhao from top to bottom, and his contempt could be seen from the corners of his upturned mouth: "What's the use of telling you!"
Qiao Zhao has an open-minded and open-minded temperament. Normally, she might casually joke a few words to ease the awkward atmosphere, but her family has suffered a catastrophe, and no matter how open-minded she is, she has no intention of chatting at the moment. Seeing that he has no intention of talking, she no longer insists, and says "oh" lightly, picks up the chess piece that Chi Can threw back, and then plays the end game with herself.
Chi Can was originally waiting for her to answer, but he just waited for the little girl to say "Oh" and started to amuse himself. At that moment, his breath was held in his throat, he couldn't come up or down, and his handsome face turned dark.
"Oh" is definitely the most annoying reply, bar none! Chi Can gritted his teeth and thought.
Zhu Yan couldn't see it, put his fist to his lips and coughed softly: "Xixi, I'm sorry, if I hadn't wanted to see Mr. Qiao's painting, the painting would not have been destroyed, and I wouldn't have caused you to travel all this way in vain -"
He was particularly tolerant of his friend Chi Can. He waved his hand and said, "It's boring to talk about this now. I'll just think of another way."
“My father still has a picture of Han’s ‘Five Cows’ in his hand.’——”
Chi Can interrupted Zhu Yan: "My mother is not interested in the paintings of everyone in the previous dynasty. She only cares about Mr. Qiao's paintings. "
Qiao Zhao's eyes flashed.
Princess Changrong is curious about her grandfather's paintings?
She was thoughtful and soon thought of Chi Can who came to her door more than three years ago to ask her grandfather for advice on his painting skills.
Everyone knows that my grandfather was weak in his later years and no longer had the energy to teach others. Could it be that this person's request to his grandfather for advice on painting skills was a lie and his real purpose was to ask for his grandfather's paintings?
Given his grandfather's reputation in the literary world, Chi Canruo would probably have been rejected outright if he directly asked for painting. But this man kept pestering his grandfather in the name of asking for advice. In the end, his grandfather sent him away with a painting.
Qiao Zhao couldn't help but take a deep look at Chi Can.
At that time, this man was only fifteen or sixteen years old. He was certainly not an ordinary person.
Thinking about those rumors again, Qiao Zhao was even more confused.
Isn't it said that the mother-son relationship between Chi Can and the eldest princess Changrong is tense? How could he put so much thought into a painting because the eldest princess is rare?
